status: exact support-size and minimum-work certificate; full K10 support gluing not performed and no obstruction claimed
minimum_trial_derivation: If the K9 support records are grouped by their common labeled K8 restriction with group sizes n_g, gluing uses sum_g n_g^2 ordered face pairs. Since n_g^2 >= n_g and sum_g n_g is the labeled support size, seven missing-edge colors give at least 7*16057440 trials.
decision: Skip the full frozen-support gluing at K10. The exact lower bound already exceeds 112 million color trials; a packed implementation analogous to K9 needs a 245 MiB support array, another comparably sized overlap-record array, and a large prefix index. Resources are prioritized toward the direct exact K10 construction.
scope_warning: This certificate does not decide whether the frozen K9 distribution extends to K10. It is neither a Farkas certificate nor a global code obstruction.
